description: This file defines a health check endpoint using Flask with Flask-Smorest. It creates a Blueprint named 'Healt Check' with a single route '/' that returns a 'Healthy' message, indicating the application's health status.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView class that handles GET requests to perform a health check and return a JSON response indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the '/' route, returning a JSON object with a 'Healthy' message.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
